title: A 3D fruit fly on macOS desktop powered by the real FlyWire connectome
summary: A project that renders a 3D fruit fly on macOS desktop, using the real FlyWire connectome data. It visualizes the fly's neural network in an interactive, desktop-based 3D environment, likely for educational or exploratory purposes. The project combines connectomics data with real-time rendering, offering a novel way to explore a complete brain structure.
